newsitem.title: CHINA: FedEx to add 20 Chinese cities a year.
newsitem.headline: FedEx to add 20 Chinese cities a year.

text.p: U.S.-based delivery company Federal Express plans to expand its delivery area in China by 20 cities a year for the next five years, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

Federal Express was also considering increasing scheduled flights between the United States and China to four a week, from the current two, the newspaper quoted the company's general manager for China, E. Brooke Harwood, as saying.
"We hope our business in China will be doubled in the coming year," Harwood was quoted as saying.
Federal Express, in partnership with Datong International Transport Co Ltd, provides a service within China and now delivered to 60 cities in China, the newspaper said.
The delivery company was developing computer links to customs offices in Beijing, southern Guangzhou and Shenzhen to help speed up customs clearance of its cargoes, it said.
Federal Express is the only U.S. all-cargo carrier allowed to fly to and from China, the newspaper said.
